items.question: What is the refund window for annual subscriptions?
items.expected_answer: Annual subscriptions can be refunded within 30 days of purchase.
context: Our refund policy states that annual subscription plans are eligible for a full refund if requested within 30 days of purchase.
Monthly subscriptions are non-refundable but can be cancelled anytime.

items.question: How do I reset my password?
items.expected_answer: Go to the login page, click 'Forgot password', and follow the emailed reset link.
context: To reset your password, navigate to the login page and select 'Forgot password'. A reset link will be emailed to you and expires in 24 hours.

items.question: What's the current status of order #48213?
items.expected_answer: Order #48213 is out for delivery and expected today.
context: Order tracking system: order #48213 status = OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, ETA today by 8pm.

items.question: Can I use the API to bulk export my data?
items.expected_answer: Yes, the /export endpoint supports bulk CSV or JSON export of account data.
context: The REST API exposes a POST /export endpoint that accepts a format parameter (csv or json) and returns a signed download URL for bulk account data export.

items.question: Do you offer discounts for students?
items.expected_answer: Yes, students get 50% off with a verified .edu email through our education program.
context: Education discount program: verified students with a .edu email address receive 50% off any paid plan.

items.question: What programming languages does your SDK support?
items.expected_answer: The SDK officially supports Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Go.
context: Our official SDKs are published for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Go. Community-maintained SDKs also exist for Ruby and Java.

items.question: How long does customer support usually take to respond?
items.expected_answer: Standard support responds within 24 hours; priority support responds within 4 hours.
context: Support SLA: standard tier response time is 24 hours. Priority (paid) tier response time is 4 hours.

items.question: Is there a free trial available?
items.expected_answer: Yes, there's a 14-day free trial with full feature access, no credit card required.
context: New accounts get a 14-day free trial with access to all Pro features. No credit card is required to start the trial.
